solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.title: What goes back to the search?
solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.caption: The horizontal axis records how each system checks a candidate. The vertical axis records what the next search step learns from that check. Table 1 of the manuscript gives the criteria for each placement.
solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.alt: SolEvolve sits in the upper right of a comparison of search systems by evaluator strength and feedback granularity.

solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.title: From target to checked construction
solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.caption: Follow the red branch from Verification to see a failed candidate return for repair. The blue branch leads from a passing candidate to a comparison with known code bounds.
solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.alt: Flowchart connecting the target code, SAT encoding, solver, verification, repair, and comparison with code tables.

solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.title: Where SAT repair enters the genetic search
solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.caption: The first solver call supplies starting codes. The final call has a different job: repair a candidate after the genetic search has stopped improving.
solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.alt: Four phases of hybrid search, from solver-generated seeds through population evolution to a bounded SAT repair.

solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.title: A perfect partition of 99 binary strings
solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.caption: Each color groups a center with the legal strings one bit away from it. All 99 vertices belong to exactly one of the 15 groups.
solevolve-evolutionary-discovery.alt: Circular drawing of the generalized Lucas cube with vertices colored by their radius-one neighborhoods.

entanglement-assisted-quantum-singleton-.title: Violation of the BDH bound
entanglement-assisted-quantum-singleton-.caption: At $q=8$ and $k=2$, the starred code uses seven shared pairs. The BDH bound predicts at least twelve. The right panel shows how the largest violation depends on the field size and the number of logical qudits.

entanglement-assisted-quantum-singleton-.title: Entanglement and distance
entanglement-assisted-quantum-singleton-.caption: The stars mark three codes that save one, two, and six shared pairs compared with the fewest pairs previously listed at the same distance.

eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.title: Researcher-in-the-loop discovery
eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.caption: The researcher sets targets and inspects candidate codes. The search program proposes generators, and a separate evaluator checks the parameters.

eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.title: Changes to the search program
eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.caption: The diagram compares the seed and evolved programs for target selection, search initialization, and generator mutation.

eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.title: Code families across four fields
eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.caption: Each panel maps code length against entanglement cost for one logical qudit and target distance $n-1$. The legend distinguishes constructions, exclusions, and open cells.

eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.title: Prospective replication
eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.caption: Success rates are plotted against the number of exact evaluations, first at lengths 9 and 11, then at lengths 13 and 15.

eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.title: Longer-code replay
eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.caption: Fresh execution seeds test how often the different search procedures recover codes of lengths 13 and 15.

eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.title: Algebraic certificate dependencies
eaqecc-evolutionary-discovery.caption: The diagram traces the coordinate map through the dimension, radical, and weight arguments to the Lean certificate and the stabilizer correspondence.

self-dual-codes-building-up.title: Repeated boxed realization
self-dual-codes-building-up.caption: The matrix records the coordinate pairs retained when passing between the length-18 and length-20 self-dual codes over the field of 13 elements.
